import re, html, subprocess, time

def state(label):
    out = subprocess.run(['curl','-s','http://localhost:3000/products'],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    t = html.unescape(re.sub(r'\s+',' ', re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ', out)))
    rev = re.search(r'revision (\d+)', t)
    lap = re.search(r'Laptop \$([\d,\.]+) (\d+)', t)
    print(f"{label:34} revision={rev.group(1) if rev else '?'}  Laptop={lap.groups() if lap else '?'}")
    return rev.group(1) if rev else None

state('1. initial GET')

aid = re.search(r'\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+', open('p1.html').read()).group(0)
t0 = time.time()
r = subprocess.run(['curl','-s','-o','/tmp/post.out','-w','%{http_code}|%{time_total}',
                    '-X','POST','http://localhost:3000/products',
                    '-H','Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                    '--data-urlencode', f'{aid}='], capture_output=True, text=True)
code, secs = r.stdout.split('|')
print(f"2. form POST -> HTTP {code} in {float(secs):.2f}s")
print("   revalidated header:",
      subprocess.run(['grep','-ic','next-action-revalidated','/tmp/post.out'],
                     capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())

state('3. GET right after submit')
time.sleep(2.5)
state('4. GET a moment later')
state('5. GET again (settled)')
EOF

import re, html, subprocess, time

def rev(path='/products'):
    out = subprocess.run(['curl','-s',f'http://localhost:3000{path}'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    t = html.unescape(re.sub(r'\s+',' ', re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ', out)))
    m = re.search(r'revision (\d+)', t)
    return m.group(1) if m else '?'

before = rev()
print(f"baseline revision = {before}")

page = subprocess.run(['curl','-s','http://localhost:3000/products'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
aid = re.search(r'\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+', page).group(0)
r = subprocess.run(['curl','-s','-D','/tmp/h.txt','-o','/dev/null','-w','%{http_code}|%{time_total}',
                    '-X','POST','http://localhost:3000/products',
                    '-H','Origin: http://localhost:3000','-F', f'{aid}='],
                   capture_output=True, text=True)
code, secs = r.stdout.split('|')
hdrs = open('/tmp/h.txt').read().lower()
print(f"POST -> HTTP {code} in {float(secs):.2f}s")
print(f"  'next-action-revalidated' header present? {'next-action-revalidated' in hdrs}"
      "   <- False means the admin's page is NOT force-refreshed")

print(f"  GET immediately after: revision={rev()}   (stale copy, no waiting)")
for i in range(10):
    time.sleep(0.4)
    r_now = rev()
    if r_now != before:
        print(f"  converged to revision={r_now} after ~{(i+1)*0.4:.1f}s")
        break
else:
    print(f"  DID NOT converge, still {rev()}")
time.sleep(0.5)
print(f"  /products/inventory: revision={rev('/products/inventory')} -> {rev('/products/inventory')}")
EOF
